title: Fabric → NeoForge on one mod
text: Fabric → NeoForge on one small mod, measured end to end.
result: mmt convert moved Auto Omen (Fabric 26.3) to NeoForge with no hand edits, and its own in-game raid self test passed 23 of 23 checks there, the same as on Fabric. Pride Flags (Fabric 26.1.2, with Fabric data generation) moved too: on NeoForge its blocks, items, flammability, loot, recipes and rendered flags were checked in the game. The NeoForge Auto Omen converted back to Fabric passed the same self test.
